excerpts.content:
In order for us to update the hivechain to glamsterdam we still need to solve the eth_simulateV1 spec changes. I've created a [proposed spec change PR here](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/881) - if you're familiar with eth_simulateV1, please review, comment, thumbs up, whatever.

This will unblock a bunch of PRs and standing issues if we can get alignment.
